top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training-Primary Caregiver and Employee Transporting (26 TAC §747.1314)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not have the required transportation training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no emergency medical information for transported children.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher has not been serviced.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregivers pediatric cpr training expired 09/2023.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety (26 TAC §744.1309(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was missing the required annual training in the following topics: 1309(C),  1309 (D) (2), 1309 (D) (3), 1309 (D) (4).
